title: AAPS crash when activating local profile
symptom: In AAPS, using the profile helper to generate a local profile with the default generated name (very long name incl date, time etc) causes AAPS to crash once the profile is activated. Changing the name to something simple solves the issue.
fix: Changing the profile name to something simple solves the issue.
evidence_quote: Changeing the name to something simple solves the issue.
